title: Все маршруты (представление)
setup:

    point1 varchar NOT NULL,
    point2 varchar NOT NULL,
    cost integer NOT NULL
);

    ('a', 'b', 10),
    ('b', 'a', 10),
    ('a', 'c', 15),
    ('c', 'a', 15),
    ('a', 'd', 20),
    ('d', 'a', 20),
    ('b', 'c', 35),
    ('c', 'b', 35),
    ('b', 'd', 25),

verify:
CREATE TEMP TABLE t4 AS SELECT total_cost, tour FROM v_all_tours;

    ('a', 'e', 12), ('e', 'a', 12),
    ('b', 'e', 14), ('e', 'b', 14),

SELECT 'cities4' AS kind, total_cost, tour::text AS tour FROM t4 UNION ALL SELECT 'cities5', total_cost, tour::text FROM v_all_tours ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

negative.why: число городов вписано числом 4: на пяти городах неверно
negative.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_all_tours AS
WITH RECURSIVE tours AS (
    SELECT point2 AS last_point, ARRAY[point1, point2] AS path, cost AS total_cost
    FROM nodes
    WHERE point1 = 'a'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT nodes.point2, tours.path || nodes.point2, tours.total_cost + nodes.cost
    FROM tours
    JOIN nodes ON nodes.point1 = tours.last_point
    WHERE NOT nodes.point2 = ANY (tours.path)
)
SELECT tours.total_cost + nodes.cost AS total_cost, tours.path || nodes.point2 AS tour
FROM tours
JOIN nodes ON nodes.point1 = tours.last_point AND nodes.point2 = 'a'
WHERE CARDINALITY(tours.path) = 4;

CREATE VIEW v_all_tours AS
WITH RECURSIVE tours AS (
    SELECT point2 AS last_point, ARRAY[point1, point2] AS path, cost AS total_cost
    FROM nodes
    WHERE point1 = 'a'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT nodes.point2, tours.path || nodes.point2, tours.total_cost + nodes.cost
    FROM tours
    JOIN nodes ON nodes.point1 = tours.last_point
    WHERE NOT nodes.point2 = ANY (tours.path)
)
SELECT tours.total_cost AS total_cost, tours.path || nodes.point2 AS tour
FROM tours
JOIN nodes ON nodes.point1 = tours.last_point AND nodes.point2 = 'a'
WHERE CARDINALITY(tours.path) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT point1 FROM nodes UNION SELECT point2 FROM nodes) AS cities);
